adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);`. The new helper `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error? }`), not the parsed credential payload itself. This means `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })` will persist the wrapper shape instead of the credential key object, corrupting stored credentials for the normal (non-sync) path as well (since the helper uses `schema.safeParse` when sync is not enabled).
